notes: STO discount confirmed arithmetically as exactly Rack x 0.70 on Ground Package figures (e.g. Standard: $630 = $900 x 0.7; High: $1,120 = $1,600 x 0.7) and approximately on Full Board (390/550=0.709, 840/1200=0.70) - an STO 30% tier.

ANOMALY: the STO document's 'Park Fees' section states Maasai Mara National Reserve fee validity/date bands as 'Jan-30th June 2025' / 'Jan-31st Dec 2025' / 'Jul-Dec 2025' despite this being a 2026-dated agreement - almost certainly a copy-paste template error carried over from a 2025 document, not updated for 2026. The figures themselves ($100 low, $200 high, $50 child) match the standard Maasai Mara reserve fee pattern seen elsewhere in this project, so likely still correct in substance, just mislabeled by year.

childPolicy.raw: 0-5 years: free of charge. 6-16 years sharing with 2 adults: 50% off adult rate PPS. Below 12 in own room: 75% of double room rate.
